(men's basketball)|Galatasaray]] | years7 = 2019–2020 | team7 = Fort Wayne Mad Ants | years8 = 2020–2021 | team8 = [[South East Melbourne Phoenix]] | years9 = 2022 | team9 = [[Memphis Hustle]] | years10 = 2022 | team10 = [[Mets de Guaynabo (basketball)|Mets de Guaynabo]] | years11 = 2022–2023 | team11 = [[Hapoel Be'er Sheva B.C.|Hapoel Be'er Sheva]] | years12 = 2023–2024 | team12 = [[Çağdaş Bodrumspor|Bodrumspor]] | years13 = 2024–2025 | team13 = [[Hapoel Gilboa Galil]] | years14 = 2025–present | team14 = [[PAOK BC|PAOK Thessaloniki]] | highlights = * [[Greek Basket League Top Rebounder|Greek League rebounding leader]] ([[2025–26 Greek Basket League|2026]]) * Second-team All-[[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] (2017) }} '''Benjamin Alexander Moore''' (born May 13, 1995) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[PAOK BC|PAOK Thessaloniki]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]] ([[GBL]]) and [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]]. He played college basketball for the [[SMU Mustangs men's basketball|SMU Mustangs]]. ==College career== Moore came to SMU from [[Bolingbrook High School]] in [[Bolingbrook, Illinois]] where he was an all-state honorable mention honoree and a finalist for [[Illinois Mr. Basketball]].{{Cite web|date=2013-03-07|title=Bolingbrook's Ben Moore Named a Finalist for Illinois Mr. Basketball Award|url=https://patch.com/illinois/bolingbrook/bolingbrook-high-school-ben-moore-raiders-named-a-finbfcf311f88|access-date=2021-03-11|website=Bolingbrook, IL Patch|language=en}} During his freshman season he was named [[American Athletic Conference]] Rookie of the Week three times on November 11, 2013, January 27 and February 10, 2014.{{cite web|title=Ben Moore - 2016-17 Men's Basketball Roster - SMU Athletics|url=http://smumustangs.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=4054|website=smumustangs.com|access-date=August 15, 2017|language=en}}. He finished his college career averaging 9 points and 5.8 rebounds a game.{{cite web|title=Ben Moore, SMU Mustangs, Power Forward|url=https://247sports.com/player/ben-moore-24338|website=247Sports.com|access-date=August 15, 2017}} ==Professional career== ===Fort Wayne Mad Ants (2017–2018)=== Moore went undrafted for the [[2017 NBA draft]].{{cite web|title=Undrafted Free Agent Tracker • r/nba|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/nba/comments/6j351n/undrafted_free_agent_tracker/|website=reddit.com|date=June 23, 2017 |access-date=7 August 2017|language=en}} On June 23, 2017, Moore signed a partially-guaranteed contract with the [[Indiana Pacers]] to be able to join their roster for the [[2017 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web|title=Ben Moore to sign partially guaranteed contract with the Indiana Pacers|url=https://8points9seconds.com/2017/06/23/ben-moore-contract-indiana-pacers/|website=8points9seconds.com|access-date=August 15, 2017|date=23 June 2017}}{{cite web|title=Pacers announce summer league roster|url=http://www.indystar.com/story/sports/nba/pacers/2017/06/27/pacers-announce-summer-league-roster/433260001/|website=Indianapolis Star|access-date=August 15, 2017|language=en}} On August 15, 2017, Moore signed with the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]] of the [[NBA G League]] as an affiliate player from the [[Indiana Pacers]].{{cite web|title=Pacers Sign Damien Wilkins and Ben Moore|url=http://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-sign-damien-wilkins-and-ben-moore|website=nba.com|date=August 15, 2017|access-date=August 15, 2017}} ===Indiana Pacers (2018)=== On January 12, 2018, Moore signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Indiana Pacers]]. Throughout the rest of the season, he split his playing time between the Pacers and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]]. Moore made his NBA debut on January 24, 2018, against the [[Phoenix Suns]], playing three minutes.{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/m/moorebe01/gamelog/2018|title=Ben Moore 2017-18 Game Log|website=Basketball-Reference.com|access-date=December 5, 2018}} On September 21, 2018, Moore re-signed with the Pacers.{{cite web |title=Pacers Announce 2018 Training Camp Roster |url=https://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-announce-2018-training-camp-roster |website=NBA.com |access-date=September 21, 2018 |date=September 21, 2018}} On November 3, 2018, Moore was waived by the [[Indiana Pacers]].{{cite web|title=Pacers Waive Moore, Recall Anigbogu|url=https://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-waive-moore-recall-anigbogu|date=November 3, 2018|website=NBA.com|access-date=November 3, 2018}} ===Second Stint with Fort Wayne Mad Ants (2018)=== On November 6, 2018, the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]] announced that they had reacquired Moore.{{cite web|title=Mad Ants acquire Ben Moore and release Michael Orris|first=Ryan|last=Stevens|url=https://fortwayne.gleague.nba.com/news/mad-ants-acquire-ben-moore-and-release-michael-orris/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181118165216/https://fortwayne.gleague.nba.com/news/mad-ants-acquire-ben-moore-and-release-michael-orris/|url-status=dead|archive-date=November 18, 2018|date=November 6, 2018|website=NBA.com|access-date=November 6, 2018}} ===San Antonio Spurs (2018–2019)=== Moore signed a two-way contract with the [[San Antonio Spurs]], splitting time with the [[Austin Spurs]] of the G League, on November 20, 2018.{{cite web|title=SPURS SIGN BEN MOORE TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT |url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-sign-ben-moore-two-way-contract|date=November 20, 2018|website=NBA.com|access-date=November 20, 2018}} On July 1, 2019, it was reported that no qualifying offer was issued for Moore,{{cite web|title=Guide to 2019 contract options, qualifying offers|first=John|last=Schuhmann|url=https://www.nba.com/article/2019/07/01/guide-qualifying-offers-options-2019|date=July 1, 2019|website=NBA.com|access-date=July 1, 2019}} despite that Moore was listed in the Spurs' roster for [[2019 NBA Summer League]] hosted at [[Vivint Smart Home Arena]].{{cite web|title=SPURS ANNOUNCE 2019 SALT LAKE CITY SUMMER LEAGUE ROSTER|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-announce-2019-salt-lake-city-summer-league-roster|date=June 26, 2019|website=NBA.com|access-date=June 26, 2019}} ===Galatasaray Doğa Sigorta (2019)=== On September 12, 2019, he has signed with [[Galatasaray S.K. (men's basketball)|Galatasaray Doğa Sigorta]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.galatasaray.org/haber/basketbol/erkek-basketbol/ben-moore-galatasaray-doga-sigortada/44839|title=Ben Moore Galatasaray Doğa Sigorta'daa|date=September 12, 2019|website=Galatasaray.org|language=tr|access-date=September 12, 2019}} On December 2, 2019, he parted ways with Galatasaray.{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/galatasaray-signs-alex-poythress-parts-ways-with-ben-moore/|title=Galatasaray signs Alex Poythress, parts ways with Ben Moore|date=December 2, 2019|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=December 3, 2019|last1=Carchia|first1=Emiliano|archive-date=August 16, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220816162241/https://sportando.basketball/en/galatasaray-signs-alex-poythress-parts-ways-with-ben-moore/|url-status=dead}} ===Third Stint with Fort Wayne Mad Ants (2019–2020)=== On December 12, 2019, the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]] announced that they had acquired Moore.{{cite web|title=Mad Ants acquire Ben Moore|first=Ryan|last=Stevens|url=https://fortwayne.gleague.nba.com/news/mad-ants-acquire-ben-moore|date=December 12, 2019|website=NBA.com|access-date=December 12, 2019|archive-date=December 12, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191212211431/https://fortwayne.gleague.nba.com/news/mad-ants-acquire-ben-moore/|url-status=dead}} In a game against the [[Capital City Go-Go]] on January 13, 2020, Moore scored 17 points and grabbed a career-high 19 rebounds.{{cite web|url=https://stats.gleague.nba.com/game/2021900300/|title=Capital City Go-Go 105 - Fort Wayne Mad Ants 113|publisher=G-League Stats|date=January 13, 2020|access-date=March 22, 2020}} He averaged 13.9 points and 9.2 rebounds per game.{{cite news |last1=Cohn |first1=Justin |title=Mad Ants left with what-ifs after early end |url=https://www.journalgazette.net/sports/professional/madants/20200326/mad-ants-left-with-what-ifsafter-early-end |access-date=July 16, 2020 |work=[[The Journal Gazette]] |date=March 26, 2020 |archive-date=July 16, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200716174359/https://www.journalgazette.net/sports/professional/madants/20200326/mad-ants-left-with-what-ifsafter-early-end |url-status=dead }} ===South East Melbourne Phoenix (2020–2021)=== On November 9, 2020, Moore signed a one-year deal with the [[South East Melbourne Phoenix]] of the [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL).{{Cite web|title=Phoenix Add Moore Starpower|url=https://www.semphoenix.com.au/news/phoenix-add-moore-starpower|date=November 9, 2020|website=semphoenix.com.au|access-date=November 9, 2020}}{{Cite news|date=10 November 2020|title=Phoenix Sign Import Ben Moore|work=nbl.com.au|url=https://nbl.com.au/news/phoenix-sign-import-ben-moore|access-date=10 November 2020}} He averaged 10.4 points and 6.4 rebounds per game.{{Cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Ben-Moore/Summary/56932|title=Ben Moore Player Profile, San Antonio Spurs - RealGM|website=basketball.realgm.com}} ===Memphis Hustle (2022)=== On February 6, 2022, Moore was acquired by the [[Memphis Hustle]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|date=February 6, 2022|access-date=February 6, 2022}} ===Mets de Guaynabo (2022)=== On April 2, 2022, Moore signed with the Mets de Guaynabo of the BSN.{{cite tweet|author=La Guerra del BSN|number=1510309888865579012|title=#BSN OFICIAL: El delantero Ben Moore es el segundo refuerzo de los Mets de Guaynabo para la temporada 2022. El delantero tiene experiencia en la G League y jugo baloncesto universitario para la Universidad Metodista del Sur. Mide 6'8 y tiene promedios de 10.4 puntos por partido.|user=LaGuerraBSN|date=April 2, 2022|access-date=April 3, 2022}} He averaged 18.1 points (8th in the league), 9.1 rebounds (6th), 1 steal, and 1 block per game, with a .630 field goal percentage (7th). ===Hapoel Be'er Sheva (2022–2023)=== On July 30, 2022, he signed with [[Hapoel Be'er Sheva B.C.|Hapoel Be'er Sheva]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/hapoel-beer-sheva-lands-ben-moore/|title=Hapoel Beer Sheva lands Ben Moore|last=|first=|date=July 30, 2022|website=|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=August 14, 2022|last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }} ===Çağdaş Bodrumspor (2023–2024)=== On July 10, 2023, he signed with [[Çağdaş Bodrumspor]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]].{{Cite tweet |user=cagdasbodrumsk |number=1678394476815867909 |title=Hoş geldin Ben Moore!}} ===PAOK Thessaloniki (2025–present)=== On July 23, 2025, Moore signed with [[PAOK BC|PAOK]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]] for the 2025–26 season.{{cite web |url=https://www.paokbc.gr/el/nea/omadas/3079-o-ben-moore-mateco |title=O Ben Moore στον ΠΑΟΚ mateco |website=PAOK BC |date=July 23, 2025 |language=el |access-date=September 19, 2025 }} Moore became one of PAOK's key players during the 2025–26 season. In the regular season of the [[2025–26 Greek Basket League]], he led the league in both total performance index rating, with 390 ranking points, and rebounding, collecting 169 rebounds in 24 games (7.0 per game). He finished the regular season averaging 12.0 points, 7.0 rebounds and 1.3 assists per game, while recording four double-doubles.{{cite web |url=https://www.paokbc.gr/el/nea/omadas/3536-o-ben-moore-2028 |title=O Ben Moore στον ΠΑΟΚ μέχρι το 2028 |website=PAOK BC |date=May 13, 2026 |language=el |access-date=August 9, 2026 }} Moore also played a significant role in PAOK's run to the [[2025–26 FIBA Europe Cup]] Final. In 18 games in the competition, he averaged 10.4 points, 6.8 rebounds and 1.6 assists per game. Among his notable moments was converting two free throws with no time remaining against [[Basketball Löwen Braunschweig|Braunschweig]], securing PAOK's qualification for the round of 16. Having earned the confidence of incoming head coach [[Andrea Trinchieri]], Moore became the first player retained as part of PAOK's planning for the 2026–27 season.{{cite web |url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/basketball/greece/paok-ananewse-mexri-to-2028-o-mpen-mour/5123973 |title=Στον ΠΑΟΚ μέχρι το καλοκαίρι του 2028 ο Μπεν Μουρ! |website=Sport FM |date=May 13, 2026 |language=el |access-date=August 9, 2026 }} On May 13, 2026, PAOK announced that Moore had signed a two-year contract extension, keeping him with the club through the 2027–28 season. ==Career statistics == {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== === Regular season === {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{Nbay|2017}} | style="text-align:left;"| [[2017–18 Indiana Pacers season|Indiana]] | 2 || 0 || 4.5 || – || – || – || .5 || .5 || .0 || .0 || .0 |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2" | Career | 2 || 0 || 4.5 || – || – || – || .5 || .5 || .0 || .0 || .0 {{S-end}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.tbf.org.tr/ligler/bsl-2023-2024/basketbolcu-detay/473259 Benjamin Moore] at [[Turkish Basketball Federation]] {{PAOK B.C. current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Moore, Ben}} [[Category:1995 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century African-American sportsmen]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Australia]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Greece]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Israel]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Turkey]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Austin Spurs players]] [[Category:Basketball players from DuPage County, Illinois]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:Çağdaş Bodrumspor players]] [[Category:Fort Wayne Mad Ants players]] [[Category:Galatasaray S.K.
